messages.subject: Argent metallurgical findings — heats FA-7733 / FA-7741
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Argent have confirmed our findings. Headlines: aluminium on FA-7741 is below the AMS 4928 minimum (5.31% vs 5.50% floor), oxygen is over the 0.20% max on both heats, and there's continuous alpha-case 95-180 microns deep plus beta-flecks. Dr Aileen Frost is finalising the formal report (AMS-TR-0412).

Crucially she says the beta-flecks can only come from the original ingot casting, i.e. before it ever reached us, and the alpha-case is on the un-machined reference sections too. That should kill any 'you cooked it in machining' argument.

Helen
